sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Heard Sri Virendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri B.P.Singh, learned A.G.A.
2.
This is the third bail application.
First bail application was disposed of vide order dated 14.3.2023 and second was disposed of vide order dated 29.2.2024 respectively.

3. Applicant has approached this Court to released him on bail in Case Crime No.95 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 376(3) IPC and 4(2)6 POCSO Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly.

entities.text: Shiv Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is very disturbing that Advocates practising at Trial Court and dealing with criminal trial as in the present case, do not communicate correct facts as in present case it was wrongly intimated to learned counsel for the applicant appearing before this Court about status of trial, just a week ago that only four witnesses were examined which is absolutely contrary to records.
5.

In pursuance of an order passed by this Court, learned Trial Court has submitted a status report dated 8.4.2025 that all the prosecution witnesses have been examined and now trial is fixed for recording of statement of accused under Section 313 Cr.P.C. on 10.4.2025.
6. In the aforesaid circumstances, no case of bail is made out, since the trial is at fag end.

Accordingly, this third bail application is rejected.
7.

Learned Advocate, who is conducting trial at District Court, Bareilly is advised that since he is under a legal obligation to communicate his brother Advocate, the correct information about status of trial since it would lead to a situation where learned counsel appearing before this Court may be guilty of misleading this Court.
8. A copy of this order be placed on records of concerned Session Trial.
